newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman says it has 30,000 mobile telephone users.
newsitem.headline: Oman says it has 30,000 mobile telephone users.

text.p: Oman said on Monday the number of mobile telephones in use since the Gulf country's launch of the GSM network last October had risen to 30,000.
Telecommunications Minister Ahmed bin Suwaidan al-Balushi said that relatively cheap tariffs had spurred demand for mobile telephones in Oman, the official Oman news agency reported.

"According to preliminary studies, we had expected to have 30,000 GSM mobile users in five years from the date of its launch," he said. "But demand for the service exceeded all expectations mainly because of its low charges compared to those in other Gulf countries."
The minister gave no further details but said Oman expected to have 50,000 users of its Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM) network by the end of the year.
